# CLABOK

CLABOK is a command-line authoring tool for structured Markdown books. CLABOK is the project name; `pecia` is the command-line tool.

It keeps a book's structure, bodies, navigation and generated content in one deterministic store and renders it as a single README, as chapter files or as part files. The store is the source of truth; rendered Markdown is output.

**Requirements**

Go 1.27.3 or newer. The module has two pinned third-party parsers (`gopkg.in/yaml.v3` and `github.com/BurntSushi/toml`) behind the badge detector layer; the rest is the standard library. A LanguageTool server and a local Java runtime are optional; the tool builds and runs without them.

**Install**

```text
go install github.com/Blue-Alien-Tec/clabok/cmd/pecia@v1.0.0
```

That writes `pecia` to `$(go env GOPATH)/bin` (`%USERPROFILE%\go\bin` on Windows); add that
directory to `PATH`. Verify the installation with `pecia version`. `@latest` tracks the newest
release:

```text
go install github.com/Blue-Alien-Tec/clabok/cmd/pecia@latest
```

Prebuilt binaries for Windows, Linux and macOS are attached to each
[release](https://github.com/Blue-Alien-Tec/clabok/releases). Or build from the repository root:

```text
go build -o pecia ./cmd/pecia
```

**Quick Start**

```text
pecia book new --library --title "My Docs"
pecia book new --title "Guide"
pecia book open guide
pecia add --book guide --title "Getting Started"
pecia body set --book guide 0 --parent <chapter-id> --body "Hello from CLABOK."
pecia book close guide
pecia sync --write
```

The book is rendered to `Docs/guide`; `pecia sync --check` verifies it.

**Documentation**

The [CLABOK](Docs/clabok/README.md) book is the full guide: book model, authoring, rendering, configuration, command reference and development. Go package documentation is at [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Blue-Alien-Tec/clabok).

**Development**

`scripts/check.ps1` on Windows or `scripts/check.sh` on Unix runs format, vet, build and tests.
